name: CallRail
description: Give Claude access to your CallRail account, to analyze interaction data, manage your data and configuration, and know what marketing is working for you.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CallRail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CallRail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://emcee.callrail.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CallRail MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CallRail lists 39 MCP tools, including create_call, create_company, create_feedback, create_session_tracker, create_source_tracker, create_tag, create_user, delete_tag, delete_user, get_account, get_call, and get_call_page_views.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CallRail?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CallRail in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
CallRail requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CallRail is developed by CallRail. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
